finalists.label: May-Thurner Syndrome
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive evidence, including Doppler ultrasonography and CT scan findings.

finalists.label: Thrombophilia
finalists.why: It is supported by Doppler ultrasonography and CT scan findings, although it is less specific than May-Thurner Syndrome.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific evidence, including the compression of the left common iliac vein by the overlying right common iliac artery, which is a characteristic finding of May-Thurner Syndrome.
